movable_0._comment_timing: The accumulator integrates ONCE per control tick, across ticks, in per-second units (with n_sub Euler-Maruyama sub-steps). This is BY DESIGN and is NOT the ring attractor's 500-steps-to-relaxation-per-tick regime (EMBODIED_DDM_PLAN.md Section 0.3). Do not add internal relaxation steps.

embodied_ddm._comment_structure: --- structure / shared perception spine (identical to mean_field) ---
embodied_ddm._comment_sensory_dt: Optional. If omitted it auto-resolves to 1/(ticks_per_second*steps_per_tick) = 0.2 here. masked_policy: leak | freeze.
embodied_ddm._comment_dist_mode: none (default, matches ring attractor) | exp (x exp(-d/d_0)) | subtense (x (2/pi)arctan(r/d), bounded) | loom (x relu(alpha_dot)). Do NOT use (r/d)^2: it diverges as d->0.
embodied_ddm._comment_attention_mode: none (default) | vonmises (gate x exp(kappa_a(cos(phi)-1)), closed-loop, prone to lock-in) | saccade (exogenous fixation centre, loop-broken control). kappa_a is a primary sweep axis.
embodied_ddm._comment_normalize: divisive (default, e/(sigma_n+sum e); keeps thresholds comparable across K) | none.
embodied_ddm._comment_sigma_s: Frozen per-slot sensor bias std (drawn once per reset). NOT the same channel as MeanFieldSystem.sigma_s, which is per-tick noise on the target qualities. 0.0 disables.
embodied_ddm._comment_modulation_example: Per-target sinusoidal quality modulation keyed by target id, shape { "static_0.s#0": { "epsilon": 0.3, "omega": 0.5, "psi": 0.0 } }. Empty {} disables. Shared clock with the ring attractor (Experiment 8).
embodied_ddm._comment_accumulator_mode: lca (default, Usher & McClelland) | race (lambda=beta_inh=0) | ddm2 (K<=2, decision var x=y0-y1, validates against analytic first-passage).
embodied_ddm._comment_bifurcation_point: Linear-LCA difference modes destabilize at beta_inh == lambda_leak, independent of K. lambda1 = beta_inh - lambda_leak.
embodied_ddm._comment_y_floor: 0.0 = standard LCA rectification (the only nonlinearity). Set null for -inf (fully linear; use for the analytic first-passage comparison).
embodied_ddm._comment_scaling_mode: concentration (default, bounded [0,1]) | constant (no gating; speed = norm_scale) | magnitude (unbounded, legacy) | norm.
embodied_ddm._comment_predecision_motion: average (default; accumulator-weighted heading — existing behaviour) | midpoint (equal-weight circular mean of the seen bearings, i.e. the angular bisector for K=2, independent of the accumulator state; cuts the decision->motion arm of the embodiment loop while keeping motion->threshold) | forward | stationary (no translation and no rotation). Shared with embodied_pure_ddm.
embodied_ddm._comment_bisector_eps: Hold the previous heading when the seen bearings cancel (atan2(0,0) undefined). Logged per tick as bisector_guard_fired.
embodied_ddm._comment_commitment_mode: soft (default; concentration>=R_commit AND max w/sum w>=p_commit for hold_ticks) | threshold (first y_i>=Z; DDM-literature RT units).
embodied_ddm._comment_guards: --- guards (spatial, not options; cannot own accumulators) ---
embodied_ddm._comment_guard_mode: off (default) | drift (guard->target angular-kernel coupling into mu) | actuation (bend angle after readout, outside the decision model).

bifurcation._comment_mode: behavioral (default; fires on heading-target alignment, model-agnostic) | analytical (lambda_threshold path; LCA uses closed-form lambda1 = beta_inh - lambda_leak).
